description: This Java source file defines the GaugesPanel class, which is part of a user interface for displaying engine sensor gauges, messages, and controls in a car tuning application. It manages layout, configuration, and interaction with gauge elements, menus, and panels.

classes.name: GaugesPanel
classes.description: Main class responsible for displaying and managing a gauges panel UI, including sensor layouts, message panels, control buttons, and configuration persistence.

classes.name: GaugesPanel.DetachedRepository
classes.description: Singleton managing a collection of DetachedSensor instances, including loading, saving, and modifying the list of detached sensors.

methods.name: GaugesPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gauges panel UI components, loading configuration, and setting up event listeners.

methods.name: createMiddleLeftPanel
methods.description: Creates a panel containing the gauges grid and RPM display.

methods.name: createTopPanel
methods.description: Builds the top section of the gauges panel, combining left controls and right menu options.

methods.name: createRightTopPanel
methods.description: Creates a right-aligned panel with menu buttons for configuration options such as grid size and logging.

methods.name: createMenu
methods.description: Creates a context menu with options to toggle RPM and message panels, save logs, and reset configuration.

methods.name: prepareMessagesPanel
methods.description: Initializes the message display panel within the gauges UI.

methods.name: createLeftTopPanel
methods.description: Constructs the top-left panel with pause button, save image, RPM label, and command input.

methods.name: createPauseButton
methods.description: Creates a button to pause/resume data updates.

methods.name: createSaveImageButton
methods.description: Creates a button to save a snapshot of the gauges panel as an image.

methods.name: setSensorGridDimensions
methods.description: Adjusts the gauge grid layout, adding gauge elements according to the specified rows and columns.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Persist the gauge grid size in the configuration node.

methods.name: applyShowFlags
methods.description: Shows or hides the RPM and message panels based on current flags.
